Only one place made the list, and it has no hours or price. It's at the museum's Gatineau site, just across the river from Ottawa.

- **Where it is:** 
The museum's own page says it sits inside the Canadian Museum of History in Gatineau, minutes from downtown Ottawa.

- **Tickets:** 
A general admission ticket covers both the Museum of History and the Children's Museum.
 
Everyone needs a ticket, whatever their age.
 
At busy times, entry to the Children's Museum is first-come, first-served.

- **Hours:** The text I could read from the museum's page doesn't include them. I also couldn't confirm anything for September 4 to 6, 2027. September 6 is Labour Day, so check holiday hours with the museum before you go.

I left out two other likely stops because I only found them on third-party listings, not their own pages. These are the Canada Science and Technology Museum and the Canadian Museum of Nature. Those listings show similar daily hours, but I can't confirm them for your dates. I also didn't find a zoo, aquarium or playground page for Ottawa that I could read.
